name: SH2 Spike - AnimType Probe (SpellAnimationType)
description: Replaces Animations\MSCO_left1.hkx with the same MRh_SpellFire_Event copy while SpellHotbar_SpellAnimationType (SpellHotbar.esp 0x815) reads the fire-and-forget AIMED id 1 (GameData::kAimed.primary). Conditioned on that ONE global and nothing else. Priority sits BELOW right_probe on purpose: on a right-hand cast both are true and right_probe wins, so the log line names the more specific variable; on a left-hand cast right_probe fails and this one answers whether the animation-type global is visible at all. Neither firing means OAR sees no SpellHotbar global while the shtb state is active.
